description: Global Hydropower Simulation - Forecast_2022 is a data set deposited in CUAHSI by its authors Donghoon Lee, Jia Yi Ng (University of California, Santa Barbara). This resource contains the hydropower time series for 735 headwater hydropower dams operating under 3 different schemes – control rules, forecast-informed operations with perfect forecast, and forecast informed operations with deterministic forecast. Coverage: global; the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 299807715 bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is This resource is shared under the Creative Commons Attribution CC BY.. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
